checkpoint: Svelte retained plain slot ownership, based on fdd7f69d
changes: Shared retainedSlotNames analysis selects repeated and removable ordinary destinations. Accepted as-list children share one source frame between own and borrowed outlets. Scoped and authored lazy template snippets remain fresh. An ordinary named/default button browser bundle regression verifies retention machinery is pruned.

Generated plain.js and plain.d.ts bridge native Svelte effect roots, snippets, marked ranges and transition lifetimes. Generated rune code owns reactive lookup and child lists. No wrapper element, cloned source DOM or additional application mount is introduced. Connection observation uses the existing shared document mutation hub.

Stable source bounds and destination identities preserve nodes, edited controls, state and context through transfers and child-list changes. Empty conditional source presence is separate from destination lifetime so fallbacks appear and returning content retains first placement.

Filter rejected native elements and text through transparent accepting projection templates. Client literal input defaults use defaultValue/defaultChecked to preserve pre-hydration edits; server output remains declarative attributes.
Accepted children registered through Svelte consumers or presets dispose their retained frames when their source is destroyed. Compiler-owned lists retain their separate source-owned disposal path.

proofBeforeFix.observation: New public assertion first found an empty paragraph instead of BorrowedFallback. Dropping logical slot metadata then let a later own outlet claim returning content. Carry presence separately and preserve destination ownership while replacing its body with fallback.

Chromium mounts and disposes a preset's retained plain content failed after complete unmount: shared document observer subscribers 1, expected 0. The same test passed after source onDestroy disposed registered child frames. Six fresh/hydration cases cover all three engines in the final gate.
